text:
alex: Heads-up — PR #20488 is green locally but e2e is flaky in CI. I'd like to land before the Friday deploy freeze if possible. can someone give a quick thumbs? :eyes:

nina: can you paste the failing test logs? quick scan might show a timeout or ordering flake.

alex: sure, snippet below from the last failed job:
```
ERROR: timeout waiting for /tmp/service-socket (120s)
  at test/integration/start_server.test.ts:42
```

raj: that looks like the same intermittent start delay we've seen in the db-migration window. CI lane was saturated earlier so retries piled up.

ci-bot: Job 3124 retried 2 times due to transient test failure. Queue length at retry: 18.

nina: ok — two quick options: 1) rebase and kick CI to get a fresh run on a quieter lane, or 2) hold and move to the next rebase window (Tuesday) to avoid risking a failed canary during freeze. Which do you prefer Alex?

alex: I'd prefer to rebase + rerun now if load on CI isn't too bad. If we still see the socket timeout, we should hold.

raj: pinging @sre-oncall for CI lane status and whether we can squeeze a rerun without backpressure.

sre-oncall: CI is currently at 75% capacity for the mac/linux matrix; we can afford a single rerun but please avoid chasing retries. If it fails again, hold for the rebase window on Tue 16:00 UTC. Also, avoid merging during the Friday freeze (starts 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC).

alex: thanks. rebasing now: `git checkout main && git pull --rebase && git push --force-with-lease`

nina: once CI completes, tag me and i'll quick smoke the canary branch. If it passes, i'll approve and we can schedule landing before the freeze window opens.

ci-bot: New build started: job 3140. Matrix: linux/mac, e2e, integration.

alex: build 3140 is running. i'll stop chasing if it flakes twice; will move to hold and add to Tue rebase window.

(12m later)

ci-bot: Job 3140 finished — failure in integration (same timeout).

nina: ugh. that's 2/3 failures consistent with the start timeout. we should not risk landing before freeze. alex, please mark this as hold and add a short note about the socket timeout to the PR so reviewers know to recheck after rebase window.

alex: done — PR comment: "holding for rebase window Tue 16:00 UTC due to intermittent socket startup timeout (see CI job 3124/3140). Will rebase and retry then."

raj: good call. i'll add the PR to the rebase-window board. Can someone add a quick test to increase the start wait or add a retry in test harness? that'll reduce flakiness long-term.

nina: opened a backlog ticket for flaky test mitigation and linked PR #20488.

alex: thanks everyone. will pick this up Tuesday. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: noted. reminding teams: avoid merging high-risk infra PRs within 24h of deploy freeze.

raj: closing loop — if anyone needs eyes Tuesday morning PST, ping me and i'll rerun the queue when the window opens.
